title: Sharlene B NDE 888
content:
I retired to bed with my partner (now husband). I can't recall how long I had been asleep. But my husband reads in bed, usually for about an hour, and I remember vividly that he was still reading. I was lying on my back when all of a sudden I had such excruciating chest pain. I remember thinking that it was so bad that I thought that I was having a heart attack. I tried to hit my husband with my left arm to get his attention but I was totally paralyzed. Next thing I knew I was floating above my bed looking down at my husband and myself. I could still see him reading and I appeared to be asleep. The pain remained excruciating but suddenly I didn't feel afraid. My surroundings were pink. All of a sudden, I heard my mother's voice behind me (I never saw her - she passed away in March 1992). She told me that it wasn't my time yet and that I was to go back for my sons. I was back in my body and I could still feel the lasting effects of the pain that I had experienced in my chest. My heart rate was two hundred and thirty beats per minute and it was pounding. I told my husband about what had happened and he told me that I never moved or made a sound the whole time I had this 'experience'. I can't put a time frame on the episode but once again my husband was still reading so to me it must have been very quick.

arrival.other_being_detail: Heard mother's voice behind her; mother deceased (March 1992); she was not seen.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden excruciating chest pain; thought it was a heart attack; heart rate reported at 230 bpm after return.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pink surroundings; heard deceased mother's voice saying it wasn't her time and to go back for her sons.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred without tunnel/light; communication from deceased mother prompted immediate return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Severe chest pain continued during the OBE; surroundings described as pink; mother was heard but not seen.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My surroundings were pink.” / “She told me that it wasn't my time yet and that I was to go back for my sons.” / “He told me that I never moved or made a sound the whole time I had this 'experience'.”
